---
title: "Reference"
---

Per-function and per-script reference for the three components, generated by hand from the docstrings and script headers in the code. The code is the source of truth; when in doubt, read the docstring in the file.

| Page | Covers |
|---|---|
| [Command line](cli.qmd) | `run_model.jl`, `make_shock.jl`, `run_scenario.jl` and every script in `scripts/`, with their arguments |
| [Julia: BSATRunner](julia.qmd) | The exported functions `run_bsat`, `make_shock`, `build_scenario`, the constant `BSAT_SHOCKS`, and every `bsat_`-prefixed helper of the runner module |
| [R: pipeline scripts](r.qmd) | One entry per script in `code/processing/R/`: purpose, reads, writes, notes |
| [Python: bsat_dashboard](python.qmd) | The functions and constants of `code/visualization/bsat_dashboard.py` |

Conventions for writing these docstrings and headers are in [Contributing](../contributing.qmd).
